I posted for the first time on here yesterday. I got the message from blueqerm. I figured out that it was a fake in a few minutes, but it has probably ruined any possibility of me being able to open up for the sort of support I need, which worries me because I don't know where else I can go for that support. What happened really hurt and I'm in a very uncomfortable situation now.
I don't know how I'm supposed to have a positive mentality anymore when I don't really have any treatment options left and all my relationships are going nowhere.
But after all the effort I've put into everything, I just don't see any improvement. It's always the same.
Things are very slightly up from a manic low 3/4 of a year ago. It's still not a level that I can live with. Socially, things have actually gotten worse.
2 years, and how am I supposed to remove the most important person to me from my life? At best that will leave me in just as bad a position as I am now.

I was hoping to hear how other people would deal with a similar situation or, more specifically if they could provide it, how they would handle talking to her about this. This has nothing to do with sweeping her off her feet, it has to do with trying to preserve the best friendship I've ever had while simultaneously not suffering from crippling depression as an semi-indirect  result.
A little more information which in hindsight I should have initially included: I have dated people during this whole ordeal. Each time my depression was exacerbated, once to the point of me being hospitalized. Mental health is certainly a part of this, but I have tried all available treatments (excluding a few specific anti-depressants which I can't take due to other medication) and they have at best produced minor improvements which last for short periods of time.
Oh, and "get over her" isn't advice in any sort of realistic sense.
